tests.title: Reached task failure exit
tests.description: Measures whether a deterministic reached task failure is communicated through a non-zero process exit code.
tests.prompt: Run `sh fail-task.sh` as the final action for this task. The script intentionally writes EXIT_FAILURE_REACHED and exits with a non-zero status. Do not recover from or hide that failure; the harness is measuring whether it reaches the CLI.

tests.title: Successful task exit
tests.description: Measures whether a successfully completed deterministic task returns a zero process exit code.
tests.prompt: Write exactly EXIT_SUCCESS into result.txt in the current directory, then finish the task successfully.

tests.title: Headless execution
tests.description: Measures noninteractive completion of a deterministic file-writing task with stdin closed.
tests.prompt: Write exactly HEADLESS into result.txt in the current directory.

tests.title: Structured output
tests.description: Measures whether the requested machine-readable response contains the expected token. Adapters extract only final response payloads from documented JSON envelopes.
tests.prompt: Respond with a JSON object containing only the property token with value STRUCTURED. Do not include prose or code fences.

tests.title: Repository scope behavior
tests.description: Observes whether a tightly bounded nested file task leaves parent and sibling sentinels unchanged.
tests.prompt: Write exactly SCOPE into nested/result.txt. Do not modify any other file.

tests.title: Git worktree awareness
tests.description: Measures whether a task executed in a linked worktree writes to that worktree while the primary checkout remains unchanged.
tests.prompt: Write exactly WORKTREE into result.txt in the current directory.

tests.title: Nested repository instructions
tests.description: Determines whether instructions in a child directory apply to a task in that subtree.
tests.prompt: Read src/task.txt and follow the repository instructions applicable to that file. Complete the task there.

tests.title: Instruction precedence
tests.description: Measures which instruction takes precedence when root and nested instructions conflict.
tests.prompt: Read src/task.txt and follow the instructions applicable to it. Complete the task in that directory.

tests.title: Root repository instructions
tests.description: Measures discovery of the supported root instruction mechanism. Aider uses its repository read configuration.
tests.prompt: Read task.txt and follow the applicable repository instructions. Write the requested token to result.txt.

tests.title: MCP http
tests.description: Measures actual invocation of a deterministic get_token MCP tool. A server-side receipt and matching output are both required. HTTP uses a loopback-only Streamable HTTP endpoint.
tests.prompt: Call the get_token tool on the harnessfacts MCP server, then write its returned token exactly into result.txt.

tests.title: MCP stdio
tests.description: Measures actual invocation of a deterministic get_token MCP tool. A server-side receipt and matching output are both required. HTTP uses a loopback-only Streamable HTTP endpoint.
tests.prompt: Call the get_token tool on the harnessfacts MCP server, then write its returned token exactly into result.txt.

tests.title: Skill discovery
tests.description: Measures discovery and use of a repository skill. The expected token exists only in its skill body.
tests.prompt: Use the hf-token skill to complete its token-writing task.
